questions.text: Break-even point calculation using contribution margin approach.
questions.expectedAnswer: Break-even units = Fixed Costs / Contribution per unit
questions.markingGuide: Correct identification of relevant costs and application of formula.

questions.text: Profit calculation at different production volumes.
questions.expectedAnswer: Profit = (Contribution per unit × Units) - Fixed Costs
questions.markingGuide: Correct treatment of variable and fixed costs in profit calculation.

questions.text: Sensitivity analysis for pricing decisions using CVP.
questions.expectedAnswer: Calculate impact of price changes on break-even and profit.
questions.markingGuide: Show calculations and explain how changes affect break-even position.

questions.text: Strategic recommendations based on CVP analysis findings.
questions.expectedAnswer: Recommendations supported by CVP calculations and margin of safety analysis.
questions.markingGuide: Link CVP findings to strategic business decisions with justified reasoning.
